Hannah S.: Customer cust-640 flagged INV-7128: looks like a mid-cycle commit consolidation produced duplicate burst lines and a bad proration entry. Invoice: https://invoices.redwood/inv_7128.pdf :thinking:
Diego P.: Can you paste the billing lines? which billing window?
Hannah S.: Window 2026-10-05 -> 2026-11-04. Condensed extract from repro: ```line_item_id,desc,pool,committed,used,burst,amount
K8001,Reserved commit - apac-main,apac-main,90000,88000,0,4500.00
K8002,Burst - apac-main,apac-main,90000,12000,12000,600.00
K8003,Commit consolidation adjustment,apac,90000,0,0,-600.00
K8004,Burst - apac-consol,apac-consol,0,12000,12000,600.00
``` The consolidation adjustment K8003 removes $600 but the duplicated bursts (K8002 + K8004) still net, leaving customer overcharged ~600 USD.
Marta L.: meterings logs show commit-consolidation event cc-209 on 2026-10-20T19:02:11Z. metering-bot: Vendor feed VEND-502 also reported duplicate usage events during the window. Logs: /events/cc-209.log and /vendor/vend-502/rep1123.log
billing-bot: Duplicate-report detected from vendor VEND-502 for cust-640 between 2026-10-20T19:00:00Z and 2026-10-20T19:12:00Z. Possible double-reporting of the same token stream. Event id vend-502-dup-1123.
Diego P.: So two possible causes: (A) our consolidation flow re-tagged traffic while old pool still billed, (B) vendor double-reported during consolidation. Either way customer sees duplicate burst lines. Also noticed that the consolidation adjustment K8003 used USD rounding on an EUR-account and caused a -€20 mismatch. Customer flagged the currency issue separately.
Cecilia (Finance): Finance policy: if duplication arises from our consolidation or vendor double-reporting, we credit the duplicated burst fully and correct proration/currency mismatches. Requirements: (1) token-level dedupe (matching token hashes) for overlap window, (2) commit-consolidation event log, (3) vendor acknowledgement if vendor double-reported. Finance provisionally approves up to $750 credit pending verification. JE code: 9-005-BILL, memo: "consolidation dup credit cust-640".
Hannah S.: I've opened billing case BILL-2026-830 and attached the condensed CSV, cc-209.log, and vendor logs. Placed INV-7128 on review hold until 2026-11-08.
Marta L.: Devops will run token dedupe for 2026-10-20T18:58 -> 2026-10-20T19:15. Export path: /exports/cust-640/20261020_token_hashes.csv. ETA 3h.
Diego P.: Next steps: (a) devops confirm dedupe and produce report, (b) billing to request vendor VEND-502 confirm/reclassify duplicate feed, (c) finance to prepare provisional JE and notify accounting. Also product/infra to add persistent origin_tag during consolidation to avoid re-tagging. Filing INFRA-1044.
billing-bot: Token dedupe job queued. ETA 3h. Output: /exports/cust-640/dedupe_report_20261020.json
Cecilia (Finance): Once dedupe confirms duplication, Finance will post provisional JE and issue corrected invoice draft to the customer. Keep me looped.
